title: VanillaPrac
description: Competitive Crystal PvP, SMP PvP, Duels, Events, Training, and Practice—all in one server.
body:
# VanillaPrac

VanillaPrac is a modern Minecraft PvP server focused on competitive gameplay, skill improvement, and fun. Whether you're new to Crystal PvP or an experienced player looking to sharpen your mechanics, VanillaPrac offers a fast, polished, and constantly evolving experience.

## Features

- ⚔️ Crystal PvP Practice
- 🛡️ Sword PvP
- 🪓 Axe PvP
- 💥 Mace PvP
- 🏹 Bow PvP
- 🎯 Ranked & Unranked Duels
- 🏟️ Competitive Events
- 🌍 SMP PvP
- 🎮 Multiple Practice Modes
- 📈 Leaderboards
- ⚡ Fast Matchmaking
- 🛠️ Regular Updates
- 👮 Active Staff Team

## Why VanillaPrac?

VanillaPrac is designed to provide one place for every type of PvP player. Instead of switching between multiple servers, you can practice different combat styles, participate in community events, improve your mechanics, and compete against players of all skill levels.

Our goal is to deliver smooth gameplay, fair competition, and new content through regular updates.

## Server Information

**IP:** `vanillaprac.org`

**Version:** Java Edition 1.21+

**Region:** New York

## Community

Join our Discord to participate in events, receive announcements, report bugs, and connect with other players.

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/vanillaprac

🛒 Store: https://store.vanillaprac.org

We look forward to seeing you on VanillaPrac!
